component.name: Beluga
component.summary: File manager written with plain GTK 4

description.p: Beluga is a rewrite of KDE's Dolphin file manager in C++ with plain GTK 4, without Qt, KDE Frameworks or libadwaita.

ul.li: Icons, Compact, Details and Columns views with grouping and previews
Threaded file operations with undo and redo
freedesktop.org trash, search by name and content, UDisks2 devices
F4 opens your own terminal; custom context menu actions
Disk Usage of a folder as a tree, in a window or a pane; a Disk Usage column
zip, tar, 7z, rar and ISO files browsed like folders
An instant index of the names in your home folder for searching
A configurable tool bar and an optional Vim mode
The file chooser of other programs, through xdg-desktop-portal

screenshot.caption: Places panel and a folder in the Icons view
Split view with tabs and the Folders and Information panels

description.p: A folder's own view is saved in its .directory file, so it moves with the folder. All 63 translations are complete.
Search and file operations always report back on the main thread (a search could hang). Includes the changes of 1.1.0, which was not released.

Folder icons (also from .directory files), a Details tab in Properties, Configure Sections for the Places panel, an option to keep the trash on the home drive, drive icons in the location bar, menus that no longer scroll, and fixes from testing 1.0.0.

The first stable release: a Dolphin-like window and settings, a configurable tool bar, a Vim mode, Disk Usage as a window or a pane, zip, tar, 7z, rar and ISO files as folders, a file chooser for other programs, an instant name index for search, audio and video details, and Act as Administrator.
